# Security Headers Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on missing clickjacking protection, X-Frame-Options: ALLOW-FROM being ignored by current browsers, a CSP that allows unsafe-inline or wildcard script sources, and missing HSTS. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
